item.title: Nillhana
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Unit Cheese
  • 発売日: 2017-12-29
  • スコア: 7.38/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ニルハナ
  • 英語名: Nillhana

别名

  • Niruhana

あらすじ

Miyamori Tatsuya was spending his life in idleness, doing shady jobs and getting involved with dubious women.

“I want you to infiltrate a certain care facility and expose what’s going on inside.”

Such was the request a certain mysterious girl, Yuu, approached him with.

Captivated by her, Tatsuya accepts - but the facility in question appears to be much more suspicious than he had imagined.

  • スコア: 6.640000000000001/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: パコられ
  • 英語名: Pakorare

あらすじ

In my second year of university, I received a letter from the girl who was my first love.

Aki Sakura, the girl who inspired me when I was a child.

The protagonist, Konno Jun, arranges to meet her once more for the first time in ten years.

However… The Sakura who appeared before him was all too different from the girl he used to know.

item.title: Yume Miru Sanagi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Unit Cheese
  • 発売日: 2012-08-11
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫夢みるさなぎ
  • 英語名: Yume Miru Sanagi

别名

  • ゆめみるさなぎ

あらすじ

Shut away in her own shell, Ayame Chouno drifts through life.

Then, by chance, she lands at a facility run by a counselor—Yumeo Yakumo.

She expects nothing.

But the men there pry open a door to a world of dark, glittering desire.

Love interests include:

Yumeo Yakumo: the counselor who whispers promises of liberation, teasing out Ayame’s deepest, dirtiest cravings.
